messages.author: bacb0402e67daa77
messages.subject: How to best cite Stan
parts:
Hi all, I am working on a manuscript in which results were obtained from Stan. I used RStan and the ODE solver in Stan. What would be the best way of citing Stan using the resources featured on http://mc-stan.org/citations/?

Should I cite Carpentar et al., 2017, the RStan interface citation, or both?

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] How to best cite Stan
parts:
Agreed, any citation is great so don’t stress over it too much.
Certainly we don’t complain about using both. ;-)

One advantage of quoting the RStan interface is that it gives
the version number that you used which facilitates
reproducible research.
